worldcombat.skill.bulkup.summary: Raise Attack and Defense, with an option to favour offense or defense. These increases end with the effect.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.use.0: Open a fight by swelling up to pad Attack and Defense together
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.use.1: Lean toward Attack when pressing, toward Defense when trading
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.use.2: Raise both stats before a close-range slugfest
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.description.0: Bulk Up raises Attack by %1$s stages and Defense by %2$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.lean.on: Power-leaning: Attack +2, Defense +1; better for pressing the attack.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.lean.off: Guard-leaning: Defense +2, Attack +1; better for trading blows. Both carry the same total.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.growth.0: At level %1$s the swell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.growth.1: At level %1$s the swell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.preference.lean: Power-leaning: Attack +2, Defense +1; Guard-leaning: Defense +2, Attack +1. Both carry the same total.
worldcombat.skill.bulkup.preference.ai.m: Consider swelling up when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of bulking up; larger gives up setup more often up close.
